jobs.description:
Warehouse Operator | Flexible Schedule
Are you looking for a side job or a part-time position?
Can you work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM on a weekly basis? Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too!

For our client TVH in Waregem (located near the E17 motorway), we are looking for warehouse employees who would like to work on a flexible schedule.

We are looking for people to sort and unpack incoming parts and goods.

Your responsibilities will include:
 

 
• Sorting delivered goods. 
 
• Physically removing parts and goods from their packaging. 
 
• Checking quantities and stock counts. 
 
• Taking the initiative to keep the workplace clean and tidy. 
 
• Following all safety rules and procedures. 

 
• You can work from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. Available every other week or every third week? That's possible too! 
 
• You work accurately and are disciplined in following instructions. 
 
• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 
 
• Physical work is not a problem for you (lifting and carrying items).

• Flexible hours – work 2 days a week (but NOT Wednesdays—those are for all the other fun stuff you’re doing! ).

• Help with labeling, wrapping, packing and preparing orders using a scanning system.

• Get hands-on with the latest logistics tech and industry best practices.

• Become a logistics pro and make a real impact at one of Belgium’s largest port companies!

• You’re comfortable working independently and taking initiative.

• You must be available to work at least two days a week, from Monday to Friday.

• You’re a full-time student at a college or university in Belgium.

• Most importantly, you’re highly motivated and ready to roll up your sleeves!

• You speak English and/or Dutch fluently.

• You value safety and take responsibility seriously in your work.

You work on a production line in the cold, warm or expedition department. You fill, garnish or label products and ensure everything runs smoothly with your colleagues. You follow strict hygiene and quality rules. You contribute to a safe and organized workplace.

• Good Dutch or fluent English

• Fast and accurate working style (line work)

• Strong focus on quality and hygiene

• Neat appearance (no gel nails, visible piercings, etc.)

• Comfortable working in cold (0–4°C)

• Team player

• Experience in production is a plus

Are you passionate about chemistry and eager to take your laboratory skills to the next level? Would you enjoy working with advanced testing equipment, exploring innovative materials and learning new techniques in a professional R&D environment?

You will enjoy a varied laboratory position, receive specialised training and benefit from an attractive salary package with excellent additional benefits!

 
• 
 
Perform functional laboratory tests on newly developed chemical formulations and materials.

 
 
• 
 
Carry out photolithographic processes in a cleanroom environment, including coating, exposure and development of silicon wafers.

 
 
• 
 
Inspect coatings and patterns using techniques such as microscopy and thickness measurements.

 
 
• 
 
Conduct material characterisation tests, including tensile testing, adhesion testing, thermal analysis and chemical compatibility testing.

 
 
• 
 
Perform analytical tests using techniques such as FTIR, UV-VIS, viscosity measurements and DSC.

 
 
• 
 
Prepare and filter chemical formulations when required.

 
 
• 
 
Analyse, document and report test results, including statistical data.

 
 
• 
 
Perform basic maintenance on laboratory equipment and follow established safety procedures.

 

 
• 
 
Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Laboratory Technology or equivalent through relevant experience.

 
 
• 
 
A strong interest in laboratory research, materials testing and chemical applications.

 
 
• 
 
Accurate, analytical and attentive to detail.

 
 
• 
 
Reliable, disciplined and comfortable working according to established procedures.

 
 
• 
 
Able to work both independently and as part of a technical team.

 
 
• 
 
Good written and spoken English.

 
 
• 
 
Eager to learn new laboratory techniques and develop your technical expertise.

jobs.occupation: Innova - PMO / Project Coordinator (Product & Technology Delivery)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced PMO / Project Coordinator to support the coordination, planning and governance of cross-functional product and technology initiatives within a large organization.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure effective roadmap execution, project monitoring, dependency management and reporting.
Key responsibilities

• 
Coordinate activities across multiple projects, product lines and departments

• 
Develop, maintain and monitor project and product roadmaps, milestones and implementation plans

• 
Identify and track project dependencies, risks, critical paths and potential delays

• 
Monitor project progress, delivery activities and go-live readiness

• 
Support governance meetings, portfolio reviews and steering committees

• 
Maintain action trackers, risk registers, decision logs and project documentation

• 
Prepare dashboards, progress reports and management presentations

• 
Ensure effective communication and alignment between business, product and technical teams

• 
Identify opportunities to improve and automate reporting and coordination processes

• 
Support continuous improvement initiatives across project governance and delivery

• 
4-8 years of experience in PMO, Project Coordination, Program Coordination, Business Analysis, Product Operations or Delivery Coordination

• 
Proven experience coordinating multiple projects, teams and stakeholders

• 
Strong experience in roadmap tracking, project planning and implementation monitoring

• 
Knowledge of risk management, dependency tracking and project governance

• 
Experience preparing dashboards, management reports and project documentation

• 
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills

• 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities

• 
Languages: English and French and/or Dutch

 

Nice to have:

• 
Experience in IT, digital transformation or product-oriented organizations

• 
Knowledge of portfolio management, product roadmaps and OKRs

• 
Experience in regulated industries such as energy, banking or telecommunications

• 
Understanding of application architecture and system dependencies

• 
Experience with reporting automation, Power BI or AI-enabled tools

As a Welder/Assembler in Lummen, you will be responsible for building truck-mounted cranes and hydraulic systems for trucks. This involves manufacturing individual components and assembling various parts into complete structures.Your responsibilities will include:
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings and plans.
• Preparing and setting up welding equipment according to the job specifications.
• Carrying out welding operations using various welding techniques, including TIG, MIG/MAG and MMA (stick welding).
• Inspecting your work and ensuring that all welds meet the required quality standards.
• Performing finishing operations such as grinding, deburring and polishing.
• In addition, you will be responsible for assembling various structures and components. This includes:
• Fitting and assembling components according to technical drawings or diagrams.
• Using hand tools, power tools and machinery to assemble and secure components.
• Checking that all components have been correctly assembled and fitted.
• You will work day shifts in Lummen, as part of a dynamic team where close collaboration with colleagues is essential to successfully completing each project.As a Welder/Assembler, you will have the opportunity to make full use of your technical skills while continuing to develop your expertise. You will work on a wide variety of projects, allowing you to broaden your experience and further enhance your skills.Ready for a new challenge? Apply now and take the next step in your career as a Welder-Fitter-Assembler in Lummen!
Your profile:
• You have good spatial awareness and are technically skilled.
• You have completed training in welding and metal fabrication, or have equivalent experience.
• You enjoy hands-on work and are not afraid to roll up your sleeves.
• You have a genuine interest in technology and engineering.
• You are eager and quick to learn new skills.
• You are practical, motivated, able to work under pressure and detail-oriented.
• You are determined, driven, eager to learn and a good team player.
• You have good communication skills in English and can communicate effectively in a professional environment.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

jobs.occupation: Internship - Digitalization & AI for Wiper Blade Testing
jobs.description:
Your challenge

Join our wiper blade test department and help us make our testing processes smarter, more standardized and data-driven. You will work on practical digitalization and AI solutions together with our test engineers.

Your main tasks

• Test specification standardization
• Compare existing wiper blade test specifications and identify opportunities for complexity reduction.
• Standardize test descriptions and required information.
• Develop an AI-based solution to easily compare specifications and highlight differences.
• AI for test reports
• Develop an AI solution to search and analyze historical test reports.
• Investigate how the quality and structure of existing data can be improved.
• Create a standardized template for future test reports to enable effective AI-based analysis.
• Digitalization of test equipment
• Update the test equipment inventory, including equipment locations.
• Support the preparation and entry of equipment data into the new laboratory management system planned for 2027.
• Wiper arm digitalization & 3D scanning
• Create an inventory of available wiper arms and link them to the existing wiper arm library.
• Support the digitalization of wiper arms using 3D scanning.

• Bachelor or Master student with a technical/engineering background, for example mechanical, automotive, electromechanical or industrial engineering.
• A strong interest in digitalization and Artificial Intelligence.
• An analytical and structured way of working.
• Motivation to work with technical specifications, test reports and engineering data.
• Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with test engineers.
• Good written and spoken English, as you will work with technical specifications, reports and colleagues in an international environment.
